sl_definition.trigger: Long stop if M5 bid_low <= price; short stop if M5 ask_high >= price
sl_definition.stop_at_entry: entry Ask for long; entry Bid for short, minus/plus ATR-derived price distance
sl_definition.atr: 14 candle SMA true range on entry timeframe shifted one complete bar
sl_definition.entry_model: Ask open for long, Bid open for short, first eligible trade per day
sl_definition.stop_slippage: on 5min gap over stop fill at worse 5min open; otherwise quoted stop price
sl_definition.standard_cost: observed bid/ask plus 2 bps roundtrip assumed extra slippage
sl_definition.trade_duration: original time-based exit used unless SL triggered sooner
sl_definition.caution: M5 high/low interpolation, cannot guarantee real gap/stop fill in live execution; no fees/commissions

preserved_filters: at least 17 of 22 profitable historical months
November >1 closed trades across EA components
November strictly more net-positive trades than net-negative trades
